answer: Farming becomes a ridge bet on surviving 86 epochs of grading, and every basalt settlement recomputes the forge schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 86 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
